description: This file defines a static class 'SyMsgs' that provides system message strings used internally within the PDFsharp library, specifically for error handling such as index out-of-range messages.

classes.name: SyMsgs
classes.description: A static class providing system message strings for error reporting within the PDFsharp library, including methods for generating specific message instances.

methods.name: IndexOutOfRange2
methods.description: Generates a formatted system message object indicating an index out-of-range error, parameterized by the parameter name and its lower and upper bounds.
